name: Dreamscapes: The Sandman - Collector's Edition
storyline: Young Laura was well protected from nightmares once her father gave her the Dreamcatcher. But after his sudden death the Dreamcatcher disappeared and Laura slipped into an endless nightmare. No one could wake her up. But you can try to save Laura! With the help of Professor Sanders and his machine you can take a dangerous journey to Laura’s ghastly dreams, dispel her awes, fight her fears, solve numerous riddles of Laura’s subconscious and find clues to her redemption.
summary: Save Laura from her nightmares and help her wake up in this hidden object puzzle adventure. Collector’s Edition extras include 15 additional locations, concept art, wallpapers, screensavers and original soundtrack.
